description: Offline bloatware database. Entries are well-known, publicly documented package names of ads/analytics frameworks, OEM and carrier add-ons. Categories: ads, analytics, oem, carrier, optional. Risk: high = widely considered safe to remove, medium = review before disabling, low = personal preference.

apps.note: Serves ads across MIUI. Removing it is one of the most common de-bloat steps on Xiaomi devices.
Ad engine on China-region MIUI builds.
Device usage telemetry shipped with MIUI.
Telemetry component of ColorOS/Realme UI.
Pre-installed Facebook installer/updater. No user-facing value unless you use Facebook.
Background service that keeps Facebook components updated.
Can install the Facebook app without asking. Safe to remove if you do not use Facebook.
Samsung voice assistant. Disabling frees RAM and battery; side button may need remapping.
Listens for the 'Hi Bixby' hotword.
Camera-based Bixby Vision features.
Content/news/ad feed on the home screen for many regions.
Samsung smart-home hub. Keep if you use Samsung/IoT devices.
Basic video editor; Gallery can fall back to trim-only mode without it.
Avatar camera feature.
Editor for AR Emoji stickers.
Camera AR modes launcher.
Game library and performance profiles.
In-game overlay (FPS, screenshot, block touches).
Cloud gaming client on some regions.
Wallpaper/theme store.
Used during device migration; rarely needed afterwards.
Weather widget provider. Removing breaks the stock weather widget.
Samsung's app store. Some Samsung app updates come only through it.
Samsung backup/sync. Keep if you rely on Samsung Cloud backups.
Xiaomi app store; also pushes app ads on some builds.
Bug-report/feedback channel. No effect on daily use.
Financial services app preloaded on Xiaomi (India/China builds).
Lending service preloaded on Xiaomi India builds.
Payments app. Remove only if unused.
Video store/player preloaded on Huawei/Honor devices.
Music player/store preloaded on Huawei/Honor devices.
Huawei app store. Essential on devices without Play Services.
Oppo/OnePlus/Realme app store.
Child-profile launcher on ColorOS.
Oppo game hub.
Payments/finance app preloaded on Realme devices.
Vivo app store; known for aggressive promotion notifications.
Vivo game center.
Migration helper agent; some carrier builds push it.
Orange operator bundle/OFW component.
Video calling app. Remove if you never use it.
Movie purchasing/streaming app.
Preloaded music client; safe to remove if unused.
Suggests printer plugins; useless without a printer.
